subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 12 updates

question: Do the upgraded GitHub Actions, particularly `openai/codex-action` v1.11 in workflows supplied with repository secrets, remain acceptable for this repository’s CI trust boundary?
rationale: The patch changes externally maintained executable workflow code on privileged paths; that acceptance requires repository-owner judgment after direct upstream contract review.

options.title: Review privileged action upgrades before merge
options.body: Inspect the upstream pinned revisions and release changes for secret, token, permission, and runtime behavior, then merge if the contract remains acceptable.

options.title: Hold the security-sensitive subset
options.body: Split or defer the secret-bearing and release workflow action updates while accepting only revisions that have an independently reviewed trust impact.

options.title: Pause this grouped bump
options.body: Close or defer the grouped update if the repository does not want to absorb the reviewed upstream action behavior changes together.

recommendation.title: Review privileged action upgrades before merge
recommendation.body: Inspect the upstream pinned revisions and release changes for secret, token, permission, and runtime behavior, then merge if the contract remains acceptable.

likelyOwner.reason: It is the only supplied history signal connected to the PR’s security-routing state; a human CI/security owner should make the final decision.
